title: Electricity consumption · Agence ORE · department
description: Electricity delivered to consumers in 2024 in each department, in MWh, as reported by the grid operators and published by Agence ORE, with the split by sector and the number of delivery points. The total includes consumers on the transmission network and on distribution networks. This is annual metered energy, not peak power: it is not comparable with the modeled peak demand of the U.S. demand layer.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Unit code of the boundaries release: ISO3-level-national code, e.g. USA-2-51059.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unit name from the boundaries release; where it differs from the official geographic code, the official spelling is used (see verification.method).

fields.name: coverage_status
fields.description: covered: the unit is inside the area the source was processed for; not_covered: outside it, all values are empty (not zero).

fields.name: coverage_note
fields.description: Reason why the unit is not_covered, in English; empty for covered units.

null_meaning.not_covered: Not applicable: every not_covered unit has a reason in this field.
null_meaning.covered: The unit is covered, so there is no reason to give.

fields.name: consumption_mwh
fields.description: Electricity delivered in the department in the year, in MWh.

fields.name: consumption_mwh_residential
fields.description: Part of consumption_mwh delivered to households.

fields.name: consumption_mwh_tertiary
fields.description: Part of consumption_mwh delivered to services and public administration.

fields.name: consumption_mwh_industry
fields.description: Part of consumption_mwh delivered to industry.

fields.name: consumption_mwh_agriculture
fields.description: Part of consumption_mwh delivered to agriculture.

fields.name: consumption_mwh_unknown
fields.description: Part of consumption_mwh whose sector is not known to the grid operator.

fields.name: n_delivery_points
fields.description: Number of delivery points (sites) as counted in the source.

fields.name: n_rows_without_value
fields.description: Number of department × sector rows that the source publishes without a consumption value. When above 0, consumption_mwh and the sector columns of this department are lower bounds.

known_gaps: In 31 departments the source publishes 85 department × sector rows without a value; their consumption is not in the totals, so the totals of these departments are lower bounds (see n_rows_without_value).

Department totals are not reduced by the statistical confidentiality applied to municipalities: the department file exceeds the sum of the municipal file by 0.12% nationally; in four departments (59, 45, 80, 95) it is lower by at most 0.02%, which is treated as a difference between the two extracts.

verification.method: Rows for electricity and the data year are summed by department and sector by script from the source table. Department totals were compared with the sum of the municipal file of the same source. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build. 3 unit names corrected from Natural Earth spelling to the INSEE official geographic code.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 101 FRA ADM2 units of the boundaries release; 101 are covered and 0 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.

The source table was filtered by the stated rules and summed again by unit: 7 layer columns (consumption_mwh, consumption_mwh_residential, consumption_mwh_tertiary, consumption_mwh_industry, consumption_mwh_agriculture, consumption_mwh_unknown, n_delivery_points) equal the recomputed sums in every covered unit; the source total equals the layer total plus the rows outside the units (none).
